definitions.home_adjustment: Amounts the home itself removed on its cost report (adjustment column), for example bad debt, pharmacy or occupational therapy that Medicaid does not cover.
definitions.moved_between_lines: True when a review decrease on one line is matched by an equal increase on another: the cost was reclassified, not removed.
definitions.review_adjustment: Changes made to the cost report in DSS's review (columns marked MSLC / M&S in DSS's data, DSS's cost-report review contractor). Negative removes cost from what DSS counts; positive adds it back. The data shows the change, not the reason.
definitions.medicaid_revenue_net: Connecticut Medicaid room, board and care revenue the home reported, minus its Medicaid contractual allowance: what the home recorded as due from Medicaid for the year.
definitions.per_diem: The Medicaid daily rate DSS set for the state fiscal year (July to June). Provisional: DSS can revise it after review or audit.

caveats: Review adjustments can still change after a field audit; these files are DSS's published data as of the pull date.
Medicaid pays one daily rate per resident. It is not earmarked for particular costs, so these figures cannot show Medicaid dollars spent on a specific department.
Cost years end September 30; rate years run July to June, so a cost year spans two rate years.
